message.content: No, substantial similarity does not prove memorization. This conclusion rests on 1 key distinction. The model may have learned general patterns across 100s of similar texts, causing it to independently generate output that converges on similar phrasing. True memorization means the system stored a specific 1 item verbatim and regurgitated it. Similarity alone is merely 1 weak indicator, not proof. Researchers need at least 2 additional lines of evidence to confirm memorization beyond surface resemblance.
